+package pl.sroki.cci.android.model
+
+import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
+import org.junit.Test
+
+class CategoryTest {
+
+    @Test
+    fun `displayName trims leading and trailing whitespace`() {
+        val category = Category(id = 1, name = "  Electronics  ")
+        assertEquals("Electronics", category.displayName)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `displayName returns name unchanged when no whitespace`() {
+        val category = Category(id = 2, name = "Books")
+        assertEquals("Books", category.displayName)
+    }
+}
